en.name: Mortadella
en.summary: Unopened mortadella keeps 2 weeks from purchase in the refrigerator at 4 °C (40 °F) or below; counter-sliced or opened, 3–5 days. Frozen, 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F). It is the odd one out on a charcuterie board — cooked and moist, not dry-cured.
en.pantry: Mortadella is not a salami and does not keep like one. It is a fine meat emulsion cooked slowly in a mould: not dried, not cured to shelf stability, and therefore a cooked, moist, low-acid, ready-to-eat meat that must stay refrigerated. Out of the fridge give it two hours at most, or one hour above 32 °C (90 °F). Leaving it out on a board for a long afternoon is exactly the mistake people make with it, precisely because it is sitting next to coppa and bresaola, which are a different kind of product.
en.fridge: Unopened, 2 weeks from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, to the printed date. Freshly counter-sliced or once the pack is opened, 3–5 days: wrap it airtight, keep it in the coldest part of the fridge, and do not leave it standing on the board. Listeria grows at refrigeration temperature, and a moist cooked meat with a long chilled shelf life is the classic vehicle for it. Health guidance for pregnant people draws this distinction explicitly — non-dried deli meats such as bologna are on the avoid list, with dried and salted deli meats given as the safer choice, and mortadella sits on the avoid side.
en.freezer: 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F). It survives freezing better than most emulsified sausages because the cubes of fat hold their shape, but the lean goes slightly spongy and weeps on thawing. Freeze it in thick pieces rather than in slices — thin slices tear as you separate them and lose far more water — and slice it after thawing. Frozen mortadella is best used in cooking, in a pasta or a filling, rather than served cold on a board.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge and use within the opened window. Slice it after thawing rather than before. Never thaw it on the counter.
spoilage: A slimy or tacky film on the cut surface or on slices.
A sour, sulphurous or ammonia-like smell.
Grey, green or iridescent patches, or fat that has yellowed and smells rancid.
A puffed vacuum pack, or cloudy liquid inside it.
tips: Buy it sliced to order in small amounts rather than a large pack you will not finish.
Wrap the cut face airtight; it dries and greys quickly.
Freeze in thick pieces, never in slices.
Pregnant, elderly and immunocompromised people should heat it until steaming or avoid it.

faq.a: 2 weeks from purchase unopened at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 3–5 days once opened or counter-sliced. Frozen, 1–2 months at −18 °C.

faq.q: Does mortadella keep as long as salami?
faq.a: No. Salami is dried and cured to stability; mortadella is a cooked, moist emulsion and keeps like a luncheon meat rather than like a dry sausage.
It is a non-dried deli meat, which is the category pregnant people are advised to avoid because of Listeria. Heating it until steaming hot first is the usual advice.

zh.name: 摩塔德拉香腸（mortadella）
zh.summary: 未開封的 mortadella 自購買日起冷藏 4 °C 以下可放 2 週；現切或開封後則是 3～5 天。冷凍 −18 °C 下 1～2 個月。它是冷肉拼盤上的異類——它是煮熟且含水的，不是乾式熟成的。
zh.pantry: Mortadella 不是莎樂美腸，也不能比照莎樂美腸保存。它是細緻的肉糜乳化物，放進模具慢慢煮熟：沒有乾燥、也沒有醃到可以常溫保存的程度，因此它是一款煮熟、含水、低酸性的即食肉品，必須全程冷藏。離開冰箱最多兩小時，氣溫超過 32 °C 時最多一小時。把它放在拼盤上擺一整個下午，正是大家最常犯的錯——而錯的理由，恰恰是因為它旁邊坐著 coppa 和 bresaola，那是完全不同類的產品。
zh.fridge: 未開封自購買日起放 4 °C 以下 2 週，並依標示日期。現切或開封後則是 3～5 天：請密封包好、放冰箱最冷的位置，不要一直擺在砧板上。李斯特菌在冷藏溫度下就會生長，而「含水的熟肉 + 很長的冷藏保存期」正是它最典型的載具。針對孕婦的衛教也把這條線畫得很清楚——像 bologna 這類非乾式熟肉被列入應避免的清單，乾式鹽漬熟肉則被視為較安全的選擇；而 mortadella 屬於前者。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 1～2 個月。它比大多數乳化型香腸更耐冷凍，因為裡面的肥肉丁能保持形狀；但瘦肉部分解凍後會略帶海綿感並出水。請切成厚塊冷凍而不是切片——薄片一分開就破，也會流失更多水分——解凍後再切。冷凍過的 mortadella 比較適合入菜，做義大利麵或內餡，而不是冷的直接上拼盤。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，並在開封後的期限內用完。解凍之後再切片，不要先切。不要放室溫退冰。
spoilage: 切面或肉片表面出現黏滑、發黏的薄膜。
聞起來有酸味、硫味或氨味。
出現灰色、綠色或虹彩光澤的斑，或肥肉泛黃並有油耗味。
真空包鼓脹，或裡面的汁液變混濁。
tips: 少量現切購買，不要買一大包吃不完。
切面要密封包好，它乾得快、也很快發灰。
冷凍時切厚塊，絕對不要切片。
懷孕、年長與免疫功能低下者，請加熱到冒蒸氣或避開。

faq.a: 未開封自購買日起 4 °C 以下 2 週；開封或現切後 3～5 天。冷凍 −18 °C 下 1～2 個月。

faq.q: 它和莎樂美腸一樣耐放嗎？
faq.a: 不一樣。莎樂美腸是乾燥熟成到穩定；mortadella 是煮熟含水的乳化製品，保存方式比照即食熟肉片，而不是乾式香腸。

faq.q: 懷孕可以吃 mortadella 嗎？
faq.a: 它屬於非乾式熟肉，正是建議孕婦因李斯特菌風險而避開的那一類。想吃的話，通常建議先加熱到冒蒸氣。
